annotation.organism: Debaryomyces hansenii (strain ATCC 36239 / CBS 767 / BCRC 21394 / JCM 1990 / NBRC 0083 / IGC 2968)
function: Catalytic component of the COMPASS (Set1C) complex that specifically mono-, di- and trimethylates histone H3 to form H3K4me1/2/3. Binds RNAs which might negatively affect its histone methyltransferase activity. COMPASS recognizes ubiquitinated H2B on one face of the nucleosome which stimulates the methylation of H3 on the opposing face.
